title: 第12章 古国皇女求药
content_zh:
火州，乃荒天仙域三千道州之一。
其面积范围，远没有君家所在的皇州大，甚至于只有皇州的百分之一。
但即便只有皇州的百分之一，火州也依然是一片广袤的道州。
在火州上，并没有纷繁矗立的势力。
统领整个火州的，乃是朱雀古国。
朱雀古国，是一方传承悠久的古国势力，纵使不如荒古世家，但也底蕴深厚，有着赫赫威名。
除了朱雀古国外，还有青龙古国，白虎古国，玄武古国。
四大古国，并称为四象古国。
此刻，朱雀古国皇宫内，一处金碧辉煌的大殿。
一位身着赤金色朱雀长袍的中年男子，正躺在床榻之上，印堂发黑，全身气息虚弱，好似身染重病，命如残火。
他正是朱雀古国的国主。
在床榻边上，站着一位美丽女子。
她身桌红色羽衣，身材袅娜，双腿修长，肌肤雪白。
红色的长发，宛如跃动着火焰。
一双美眸呈现美丽的绯晶色，玉鼻高挺，红唇鲜艳，贝齿晶莹。
特别是她眉心有一点朱砂，配上整张玉容，更显得艳若桃李，妩媚绝伦。
此女，正是朱雀古国皇女，拜玉儿。
“父皇，玉儿一定会找到不死药解救您。”拜玉儿紧咬芳唇道。
“玉儿，难为你了，不死药强求不来……”朱雀国主微微摇头，语气虚弱至极，同时也有着绝望。
不死药，那是何等稀有的存在。

连那些无上道统，不朽势力，都不可能有多少库存。
更不可能那么好心交给朱雀古国。
朱雀古国底蕴虽强，也拥有不少顶级圣药，但不死药，却是一株都没有。
毕竟放眼外界，一株不死药出世，都会掀起一番血雨腥风，争夺都来不及，怎么可能会卖给别人？
“父皇放心，凭借玉儿的本事，一定能够得到不死药！”拜玉儿美眸坚定，化悲痛为力量。
她是谁？
朱雀古国皇女，眉心蕴有朱雀神火，天赋超凡。
更不要说其容貌，在荒天仙域，也算排得上号的。
不少势力的年轻天骄，都是拜玉儿的舔狗。
因此，养成了拜玉儿那有些矜贵和高高在上的性格。
她相信，自己一定有能力解救父皇，解救整个朱雀古国。
“那些势力的年轻天骄，一个个都是废物，需要他们的时候，根本拿不出不死药。”
“还有我那未婚夫萧尘，身为青龙古国大皇子，竟然也无法拿来一株不死药。”
拜玉儿走出皇宫，玉脸沉然。
在她父皇出事几年后，朱雀古国的国力每况愈下。
之后青龙古国前来联姻。
那时候，青龙古国答应，会给朱雀古国一株不死药。
拜玉儿和那青龙古国大皇子萧尘，从小相识，虽然一直保持距离，但也算是青梅竹马，关系不差。
内心权衡过后，拜玉儿才答应。
结果过了这么长时间，婚约是早就定下来了，但不死药却一直不见踪影。

而现在的朱雀古国国力衰弱，也没有能力向青龙古国讨取。
因此，只能靠拜玉儿自己去寻找不死药。
“该怎么办，父皇不能倒下……”拜玉儿心里不禁有些焦急。
“对了，怎么差点忘了，我的那位闺蜜，君玲珑？”拜玉儿忽然想到。
她曾在一次秘境中，偶遇君玲珑，彼此相处的也还算不错。
虽说后来没有怎么联系了，但以君玲珑的性格，想必不会视而不见。
再者，君家也绝对拥有不死药。
想到这里，拜玉儿呼吸急促，急忙拿出一枚玉简，传递消息。
另一边，君家天帝宫偏殿，君玲珑也是收到了消息。
“朱雀国主重疾在身，需要不死药医治？”君玲珑得知消息后，微蹙柳眉。
说实话，如果不是拜玉儿传讯，她都差点忘了这位“闺蜜”。
拜玉儿虽是古国皇女，身份尊贵。
但君玲珑更是荒古世家的天之骄女。
别看她现在是君逍遥的丫鬟，但是走出外界，依然是受四方追捧的君家贵女。
“一开口就是一株不死药，胃口倒是不小，不过和她好歹也算相识一场。”君玲珑微微蹙眉。
但问题是，她没有不死药。
这时，一道神魂传音，落入君玲珑脑海当中。
“玲珑，泡茶。”
君玲珑急忙起身，这是君逍遥在叫她去泡茶。
一处热气腾腾，仙气盎然的池水中，君逍遥赤着上半身，身躯如仙玉雕琢而成，晕着流光。

已经八岁的君逍遥，身材欣长。
一旁，君玲珑进入，端了一杯悟道茶给君逍遥。
看着君逍遥渐渐长开，变得越来越神秀俊逸，君玲珑有种正太养成的错觉。
“怎么了，有事？”君逍遥抿了一口茶水，淡淡道。
“没有。”君玲珑睫毛微微一颤。
“说吧，瞒得过我吗？”君逍遥摇头一笑。
君玲珑微微咬唇，终究还是把拜玉儿的事情说了出来。
“原来如此，不死药吗，我倒是不缺。”君逍遥耸了耸肩。
在泰岳古碑时，他得到了三株不死药，后来十八祖又陆陆续续给了他五株不死药。
君逍遥这些年来，只炼化了三株而已，还剩下五株。
“既然是你的闺蜜，给一株也未尝不可，让她过来吧。”君逍遥摆摆手道。
“这就给了？”君玲珑都是微微愣住。
土豪的世界，她果然不懂！
不过君玲珑还是微微点头，回讯给拜玉儿。
君逍遥嘴角带着一抹淡淡笑意。
他自然不是想当老好人，而是有自己的想法和打算。
这正道的光，还是让那些正道栋梁来当吧。
圣母之类的人设，可不适合他。
再说一株不死药，君逍遥虽然不重视，却也没有大气到可以随手送人的程度。
“君家那些序列，背后不仅有各脉支持，甚至还有附庸的道统势力。”

“哪怕是那君仗剑，背后也有古剑宗等附庸势力。”
这种附庸势力，不是臣服君家，而是臣服个人。
“朱雀古国，虽然近年来国力衰微，但瘦死的骆驼比马大，倒是可以收揽过来，说不定还可以顺便把其他三个古国也一并收为附庸势力。”
君逍遥心里打着算盘。
他毕竟是零号序列，若背后一个附庸势力都没有，那未免有些寒碜。
该有的牌面，还是得有的。
至于那拜玉儿，想白白得到一株不死药，那怎么可能？
君逍遥可不是做慈善的，对自己无益的事情，他是不会做的。
而得到了君玲珑回复的拜玉儿，也是惊喜异常。
这种感觉，如同久旱逢甘霖。
只是君玲珑传过来的话，令拜玉儿陷入了思索。
因为要给她不死药的，并非是君玲珑本人。
“君家的一位天之骄子，答应给我一株不死药，莫非是看上我了？”
拜玉儿不由想到。
她对自己的容貌，还是颇为自信的，乃是朱雀古国第一美人。
在整个荒天仙域，也算颇有美名。
在她的思维中，舍得给她一株不死药的人，一定是馋她的身子。
“果然，哪怕是君家的天骄，也难以免俗。”拜玉儿心中莫名感觉有点失望。
君家天骄，貌似也没有想象中的那么超凡脱俗。
“不过不论怎样，先得到不死药拯救父皇再说。”

拜玉儿摇了摇头，启程前往皇州。
content_en:
Huozhou is one of the three thousand states in the Huangtian Immortal Domain.
Its area is far less than that of Huangzhou, where the Jun family is located, or even only one percent of Huangzhou.
But even if it is only one percent of Huangzhou, Huozhou is still a vast Daozhou.
In Huozhou, there are no numerous and powerful forces.
The leader of the entire Fire State is the ancient Suzaku Kingdom.
The ancient Suzaku country is an ancient country with a long heritage. Even though it is not as good as the ancient family, it still has a profound foundation and a great reputation.
In addition to the Suzaku Ancient Country, there are also the Qinglong Ancient Country, the White Tiger Ancient Country, and the Xuanwu Ancient Country.
The four ancient countries are collectively called the Four Elephant Ancient Countries.
At this moment, there is a magnificent hall in the ancient palace of Zhuque.
A middle-aged man wearing a red-gold Suzaku robe was lying on the bed. His hall was black, and his whole body was weak, as if he was seriously ill and his life was like a residual fire.
He is the leader of the ancient Suzaku Kingdom.
Beside the bed stood a beautiful woman.
She wears a red feather coat, has a graceful figure, slender legs, and white skin.
The long red hair looked like dancing flames.
A pair of beautiful eyes with a beautiful crimson color, a tall jade nose, bright red lips, and sparkling teeth.
In particular, there is a little cinnabar between her eyebrows, which together with her jade face makes her look even more gorgeous and charming.
This girl is none other than the princess of the ancient Zhuque Kingdom, Bai Yuer.
"Father, Yu'er will definitely find the elixir to save you." Bai Yu'er bit her lips tightly and said.
"Yu'er, I'm in trouble for you, I can't force the elixir to come..." The Lord of the Suzaku Kingdom shook his head slightly, his tone was extremely weak, but also full of despair.
The elixir of death is such a rare existence.
Even those supreme orthodoxy and immortal forces cannot have much inventory.
It is even more impossible to hand it over to Zhuque Ancient Country so kindly.
Although the ancient Suzaku Kingdom has a strong foundation and possesses many top-notch holy medicines, it does not have a single elixir.
After all, looking at the outside world, the birth of an elixir will cause a bloody storm. There is no time to fight for it, so how can it be sold to others?
"Father, don't worry, with Yu'er's ability, we will definitely be able to get the elixir!" Bai Yu'er's beautiful eyes were firm, turning grief into strength.
who is she?
The princess of the ancient Suzaku Kingdom has the Suzaku Divine Fire between her eyebrows and has extraordinary talents.
Not to mention his appearance, he is considered to be one of the best in the Desolate Heaven Immortal Realm.
Many young prodigies from various factions are licking dogs who worship Yu'er.
Therefore, Bai Yuer developed a somewhat noble and aloof character.
She believed that she would be able to save her father and the entire Suzaku Ancient Kingdom.
"The young prodigies of those forces are all useless. When they are needed, there is no way they can produce the elixir."
"And my fiancé Xiao Chen, as the eldest prince of the ancient Qinglong Kingdom, can't even get a single elixir."
Bai Yuer walked out of the palace with a serious look on her face.
A few years after her father's accident, the ancient Suzaku country's national power deteriorated.
Later, the ancient Qinglong Kingdom came to have a marriage alliance.
At that time, the Ancient Qinglong Kingdom promised to give the Ancient Suzaku Kingdom an elixir of immortality.
Bai Yu'er and Xiao Chen, the eldest prince of the ancient Qinglong Kingdom, have known each other since childhood. Although they have always kept a distance, they can be regarded as childhood sweethearts and have a good relationship.
After weighing it in his heart, Bai Yuer agreed.
As a result, after such a long time, the engagement was already finalized, but the elixir was still missing.
But now that the ancient Suzaku country is weak, it has no ability to ask for it from the ancient Qinglong country.
Therefore, Bai Yuer can only rely on himself to find the elixir.
"What should we do? Father cannot fall..." Bai Yu'er couldn't help but feel anxious.
"By the way, why did I almost forget, my best friend, Jun Linglong?" Bai Yu'er suddenly thought.
She once met Jun Linglong by chance in a secret realm, and they got along pretty well.
Although there was not much contact later, with Jun Linglong's character, she would not turn a blind eye.
Furthermore, the Jun family definitely has the elixir.
Thinking of this, worship jadeEr's breathing was rapid and he hurriedly took out a jade slip to convey the message.
On the other side, Jun Linglong also received the news in the side hall of the Jun family's Heavenly Emperor's Palace.
"The Lord of the Suzaku Kingdom is seriously ill and needs elixir for treatment?" Jun Linglong frowned slightly after hearing the news.
To be honest, if Bai Yu'er hadn't been summoned, she would have almost forgotten about this "best friend".
Although Bai Yu'er is a princess of an ancient country, she has a distinguished status.
But Jun Linglong is the proud daughter of the ancient family.
Even though she is Jun Xiaoyao's maid now, when she goes out to the outside world, she is still the noble daughter of the Jun family who is sought after by everyone.
"She's like an elixir as soon as she opens her mouth. She has quite an appetite, but at least we can be considered acquaintances with her." Jun Linglong frowned slightly.
But the problem is, she doesn't have the elixir.
At this time, a message from the soul fell into Jun Linglong's mind.
"Linglong, make tea."
Jun Linglong stood up in a hurry. Jun Xiaoyao was telling her to make tea.
In a pool of steaming water full of fairy spirit, Jun Xiaoyao's upper body was naked, his body was like a fairy jade carving, and he was dizzy with flowing light.
Jun Xiaoyao, who is eight years old, has a good figure.
On the side, Jun Linglong entered and brought a cup of enlightenment tea to Jun Xiaoyao.
Seeing Jun Xiaoyao gradually blooming and becoming more and more handsome, Jun Linglong had the illusion of being a young lady.
"What's the matter? Is something wrong?" Jun Xiaoyao took a sip of tea and said calmly.
"No." Jun Linglong's eyelashes trembled slightly.
"Tell me, can you hide it from me?" Jun Xiaoyao shook his head and smiled.
Jun Linglong bit her lip slightly, and finally told her about Bai Yu'er.
"I see, I'm not short of the elixir, right?" Jun Xiaoyao shrugged.
When he was at the Taiyue Ancient Monument, he got three elixirs, and later the Eighteenth Ancestor gave him five more elixirs one after another.
Jun Xiaoyao has only refined three plants over the years, and there are still five plants left.
"Since she is your best friend, it's not a bad idea to give her one. Let her come over." Jun Xiaoyao waved his hand.
"You're giving it to me?" Jun Linglong was slightly stunned.
She really doesn’t understand the world of rich people!
However, Jun Linglong still nodded slightly and replied to Bai Yu'er.
There was a faint smile on Jun Xiaoyao's lips.
Naturally, he doesn't want to be a good guy, but has his own ideas and plans.
Let those who are the pillars of the righteous path be the light of the righteous path.
Characters like the Virgin are not suitable for him.
As for the elixir, although Jun Xiaoyao didn't pay much attention to it, he was not generous enough to give it away casually.
"Those sequences in the Jun family are not only supported by various lineages, but also vassal Taoist forces."
"Even if the king is holding a sword, there are vassal forces such as the Ancient Sword Sect behind him."
This kind of vassal force does not submit to the monarch's family, but to individuals.
"Although the ancient country of Suzaku has declined in recent years, its emaciated camel is bigger than a horse. It can be taken over. Maybe it can also take the other three ancient countries as vassal forces."
Jun Xiaoyao was making calculations in his mind.
After all, he is in Sequence Zero. If there is no vassal force behind him, it would be a bit shabby.
The cards that should be there still have to be there.
As for Bai Yuer, if he wants to get an elixir for nothing, how is that possible?
Jun Xiaoyao is not a philanthropist. He will not do anything that is not beneficial to him.
Bai Yu'er, who received Jun Linglong's reply, was also extremely pleasantly surprised.
This feeling is like a long drought followed by sweet rain.
But the words passed by Jun Linglong made Bai Yuer fall into thinking.
Because it was not Jun Linglong himself who wanted to give her the elixir.
"A proud man of the Jun family promised to give me an elixir of death. Could it be that he is attracted to me?"
Bai Yu'er couldn't help but think of it.
She is quite confident in her appearance, and is the most beautiful woman in the ancient Suzaku country.
It is quite famous in the entire Desolate Heaven and Immortal Realm.
In her mind, anyone who was willing to give her an elixir must be greedy for her body.
"Sure enough, even the genius of the Jun family is not immune to vulgarity. "Bai Yu'er felt a little disappointed for no reason.
The genius of the Jun family seems not to be as extraordinary as imagined.
"But no matter what, let's get the elixir first to save my father. "
Bai Yuer shook his head and set off for Huangzhou.
